prompt: In a minimalist white gallery, place a clear perfume bottle on a mirrored plinth, with a silk glove draped beside it and a gold key leaning against the mirror. The bottle’s spray mist forms a floating ring; when the key rotates through the mist ring, the perfume inside shifts from clear to deep teal. The teal liquid seeps into the mirror reflection, causing the glove to animate, stand upright, and gently “applaud” the bottle.

rubric.title: Cinematography
rubric.goal: Evaluate cinematic techniques matching the emotional tone and narrative purpose
criteria: Camera language should feel neutral and balanced: stable tripod, slow controlled dolly/slider, or subtle push-in at the causal moments (mist ring formation, key passing through ring, liquid color shift, seep into reflection, glove applause). No frantic handheld or aggressive zooms.

Shot design should clearly stage the spatial relationship: bottle centered/hero, mirrored plinth readable, glove visibly draped beside bottle, gold key clearly leaning against mirror/plinth and later rotating through the mist ring without leaving frame clarity.

Composition should leverage symmetry and negative space typical of a minimalist gallery; reflections should be intentionally framed so the seep into the mirror reflection is unmistakable (e.g., include both real object and its reflection in the same shot).

Lighting should be soft, clean, gallery-like (diffuse key + gentle fill) with controlled specular highlights on glass and gold; avoid harsh clipping, noisy shadows, or colored lighting that overrides the teal transformation.
Color grading should remain high-key and neutral whites with subtle contrast; the deep teal should read as the primary color accent and remain consistent across shots and in reflections.
Focus strategy should support narrative: shallow depth of field acceptable but must not blur away key evidence (mist ring, key crossing ring, teal change, seep into reflection, glove applause).
Transitions and pacing should be smooth and deliberate; cuts (if any) must preserve continuity of object placement and causal chain, with enough on-screen time to perceive each transformation.

Visual style consistency: maintain the same minimalist gallery setting, lighting direction, and mirror behavior across the full clip; no sudden style shifts (film grain spikes, vignette changes, abrupt exposure swings).

anchors.1: Cinematic techniques are contradictory: chaotic camera, unclear staging, or lighting/grade obscures the mist ring, color shift, reflection seep, or glove applause; mood not neutral/balanced.
anchors.2: Major mismatches: frequent reframing that loses key entities, over-dramatic angles or lighting, or cuts that break the causal sequence; reflections not legible.
anchors.3: Functional but plain: mostly stable and readable, yet composition/lighting/focus occasionally hides crucial moments or the teal accent; pacing may feel rushed or dull.
anchors.4: Good cinematic execution: clean minimalist look, clear reflection framing, and well-timed emphasis on causal beats; only minor issues (brief focus hunting, slight highlight clipping, small continuity jump).
anchors.5: Excellent: refined gallery aesthetic, precise staging and reflection-aware framing, subtle camera moves that highlight each transformation beat, consistent high-key grade with teal as controlled accent, seamless pacing.

rubric.title: Visual purity
rubric.goal: Evaluate whether video contains ONLY elements specified in the prompt
criteria: Required entities present and identifiable: clear perfume bottle, mirrored plinth (with mirror surface/reflection), silk glove, gold key.

Environment limited to a minimalist white gallery: plain white walls/floor and neutral gallery ambience; no additional decor (paintings, sculptures, signage) unless strictly necessary and still minimalist (prefer none).
No extra characters: no humans, hands, faces, mannequins, animals, or additional gloves.
No extra props: no flowers, books, jewelry (other than the specified gold key), trays, labels, brand logos, ribbons, candles, dust particles presented as separate objects, or additional bottles.
Text/graphics: no subtitles, watermarks, UI overlays, brand names on bottle, or extraneous typography on walls.
Mirror/plinth scope: mirror should not reveal additional rooms, windows, or off-scene objects; the reflection should only contain the specified items and minimalist white surroundings.

No extraneous atmospheric effects: apart from the perfume mist ring, avoid smoke, fog, sparkles, magical particles, lens flares as separate effects, or color blooms not motivated by lighting/materials.
Maintain continuity: specified objects should not duplicate (two keys, two bottles) or morph into unrelated items.
focus_points: Reflection does not introduce new objects

anchors.1: Many extra elements: additional props/characters/scenes, text overlays, or reflections showing unrelated objects; prompt scope heavily violated.
anchors.2: Several unrequested additions: extra decor, multiple bottles/keys, noticeable background items, or mirror reveals off-scene clutter.
anchors.3: Mostly on-prompt with 1-2 clear extras: minor decor item, faint watermark, small unintended object in reflection, or subtle extra atmospheric particles.
anchors.4: Nearly perfect: only microscopic, easily ignorable extras (tiny dust/spec highlights) with no new distinct objects; all key entities and minimalist gallery remain dominant.
anchors.5: Perfect purity: only the perfume bottle, mirrored plinth/mirror, silk glove, gold key, and minimalist white gallery surfaces appear; no text, no extra props, no unintended reflection content.

rubric.title: Motion smoothness
rubric.goal: Evaluate the naturalness and fluidity of all motions and interactions
criteria: Mist emission and ring formation should be continuous: no frame skipping, popping, or sudden on/off toggles; ring should cohere smoothly as it forms.
Key rotation through the mist ring should have stable angular velocity (or intentionally eased) without jitter, wobble artifacts, or sudden axis changes; the path through the ring should be readable.
Color transition (clear to deep teal) should be temporally smooth: gradual spread or cleanly animated shift without flickering between colors or noisy patching inside the bottle.
Teal seep into mirror reflection should propagate smoothly across time (spreading/flowing) rather than appearing as discontinuous blobs or flashing frames.

Glove animation should be fluid and gentle: rising to stand upright with believable acceleration/deceleration; applause cycles should have consistent rhythm, clear contact moments, and no staccato snapping.
Camera motion (if any) should be stable with no micro-jitters, rolling-shutter warps, or sudden reframing that interrupts perception of transformations.
Inter-shot continuity: if cuts exist, motion states should match across cuts (key orientation, ring position, liquid color state, glove posture) to avoid discontinuous jumps.

anchors.1: Severe motion artifacts: frequent jitter, freezes, popping, teleporting, or inconsistent frame-to-frame positions; key actions are hard to follow.
anchors.2: Noticeable irregularities in key beats: key rotation jitters, mist ring flickers, teal change flashes, seep effect pops, or glove applause snaps.
anchors.3: Generally smooth with occasional hiccups: minor stutters or brief flicker during transformations; motions remain understandable.
anchors.4: Smooth and pleasing: coherent easing and continuity for mist, key rotation, color shift, seep propagation, and glove applause; rare minor micro-jitter or small discontinuity.
anchors.5: Exceptionally fluid: all motions and transformations are continuous, stable, and naturally timed; no visible jitter, popping, or continuity breaks.

rubric.title: Physics adherence
rubric.goal: Evaluate whether all interactions and state changes follow normal physical laws
criteria: Static stability: perfume bottle must rest stably on the mirrored plinth (no sliding without cause); glove should drape with believable fabric folds; key should lean with a plausible contact point and center-of-mass support.

Mirror behavior: reflections should follow correct geometry (consistent with camera viewpoint); objects should not appear/disappear or distort inconsistently unless explicitly driven by the teal seep effect.

Mist spray behavior: spray emission should originate from the bottle nozzle; mist should disperse like aerosol (turbulence, diffusion) while forming a ring in a controlled, dreamlike but coherent way (ring can be stylized, but must not teleport or flicker).
Ring stability: the floating mist ring should maintain a consistent position/shape with plausible motion (gentle drift), not jittering, snapping, or changing scale randomly.

Key rotation: key should rotate with continuous angular motion, maintaining rigid-body integrity (no bending/warping) and consistent axis; it should pass through the ring with a clear intersection timing.

Causal timing: the liquid color change from clear to deep teal should occur after (not before) the key passes/rotates through the ring; transformation should be temporally continuous (no frame-to-frame instant swaps unless shown as a deliberate stylized transition).

Liquid behavior: perfume liquid should remain contained within the bottle; color shift should not cause volume to change unnaturally; refractive properties may change but must remain coherent with glass and lighting.

Teal seep into reflection: the effect can be surreal, but should be presented as a coherent propagation across the mirror image (e.g., spreading/flowing) with consistent directionality and speed; avoid random patches appearing without continuity.

Glove animation: glove standing upright and applauding is inherently surreal; evaluate internal consistency of motion and contacts—base contact with plinth should look grounded, folds should respond like fabric, and applause should involve believable deformation and collision between glove fingers/palm surfaces without interpenetration.
No impossible interpenetrations: bottle, key, and glove should not clip through each other or through the mirror/plinth; contact points should be visible and consistent.
focus_points: Realistic material behavior (glass, metal, fabric, aerosol)

anchors.1: Severe violations throughout: objects float/teleport, major clipping, reflection behaves randomly, mist originates incorrectly, or causal order is reversed (teal before key-through-ring).
anchors.2: Major physical errors in key beats: unstable leaning key, bottle sliding, mist ring flickering/teleporting, reflection seep discontinuous, glove applause has heavy interpenetration or non-contact motion.
anchors.3: Mostly coherent with noticeable implausibilities: minor clipping, slight reflection mismatch, mist ring behavior not fully consistent, or glove deformation looks partially rubbery; causal order still generally correct.
anchors.4: Good physical believability for a dreamlike premise: stable placements, consistent reflection geometry, plausible aerosol motion and ring stability, continuous color shift timing, glove motion grounded with only minor artifacts.
anchors.5: Excellent: all rigid-body contacts, aerosol dynamics, fabric deformation, and reflection consistency feel natural; surreal effects (ring and reflection seep) are implemented with continuous, rule-consistent propagation and clean causal timing.
